# The Berkshire Edge

> > The Berkshire Edge is a regional news publication covering local journalism, community events, arts, and lifestyle content for Berkshire County, Massachusetts.

The Berkshire Edge serves the Berkshires region with comprehensive coverage of local news, cultural events, public affairs, and community resources. The publication offers membership subscriptions, advertising opportunities, and curated content including wedding planning guides, real estate reports, and arts reviews.

## Key Topics

- Berkshire County
- Local News
- Community Events
- Berkshires Arts & Culture
- Pittsfield
- Great Barrington
- Public Safety
- Local History
- Wedding Planning
- Regional Publication
- Viewpoints & Opinion
- Real Estate
- Film & Theater Reviews
- Berkshire Film Festival
- Membership

- [Welcome to Real Estate Friday!](https://theberkshireedge.com/welcome-to-real-estate-friday-445): Weekly real estate market report and property listings
